Albi Abraham vs Food Safety And Standards Authority Of ... on 
12 August, 2024 
Author: Chandra Dhari Singh Bench: Chandra Dhari Singh  $~A-80  * IN THE HIGH COURT OF DELHI AT NEW DELHI  + W.P.(C) 11542/2023 & CM APPL. 44948/2023  ALBI ABRAHAM   Through: 
 
 versus  FOOD SAFETY AND STANDARDS AUTHORITY OF INDIA &
 ANR. .....Res  Through: Mr.Aditya Singla and Ms.Saaks  Garg, Advocates for FSSAI  Ms. Anju Gupta and Mr. Bhuvan  Goel, Advocates for R-2/UOI  CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE CHANDRA DHARI SINGH  ORDER % 12.08.2024 Let the instant matter be released from the category of "Part heard". Subject to the orders of Hon'ble the Acting Chief Justice, list the instant matter on 2nd September, 2024 before the Roster Bench. 
Interim order, if any, to continue till then.
